step1.title: Welcome, Homeowner! 🏠
step1.description: Adulting.Exe helps you manage warranties, maintenance, utilities, and more. Let's get your household set up in a few quick steps.

step2.title: Add Your First Appliance
step2.description: Start tracking warranties by adding your first appliance. You can skip this and add appliances later.

step3.title: What's Your Heating Type?
step3.description: Select your heating source so the units in the Utilities section are displayed correctly.

step4.title: Configure Waste Categories
step4.description: Add your local waste pickup types (e.g. Recycling, Organic, Paper). You can add more later in Settings.

step5.title: You're All Set! 🎉
step5.description: Your household is configured and ready to go. You can always change these settings later.

step1.title: The Warranty & Box Vault
step1.description: Keep track of every appliance you own — from the dishwasher to the coffee machine.
step1.feature1: Record purchase dates and warranty expiry
step1.feature2: Store where you keep the original box
step1.feature3: Track appliance brand, category, and price

step2.title: Warranty Status at a Glance
step2.description: See instantly which appliances are still covered, which have run out, and which are in the danger zone.
step2.feature2: Zombie: appliance past its warranty date

step3.title: Add Your First Appliance
step3.description: Hit 'New Entry' to add an appliance. Fill in the name, brand, purchase date, and warranty end date — and you're set.

step1.title: Your Service Provider Rolodex
step1.description: Store contact details for every plumber, electrician, or handyman you've ever worked with.
step1.feature1: Add phone, email, and website for each provider

step2.title: Service History Log
step2.description: Log every repair and service call so you always know what was done and when.

step3.title: Invoice Management
step3.description: Upload and attach invoices to specific service calls. No more hunting through email for receipts.

step1.title: Your Home Knowledge Base
step1.description: Store important home documents, guides, and manuals in one searchable place.
step1.feature1: Upload PDFs and write Markdown notes

step2.title: Find Any Document Instantly
step2.description: Search by title or filter by category to find exactly what you need when you need it.
step2.feature1: Filter by document type: PDF or note
step2.feature2: Preview documents without leaving the app

step1.title: Never Miss a Pickup
step1.description: Configure your local waste pickup schedule and always know what goes out this week.
step1.feature1: Add custom waste types (recycling, organic, etc.)
step1.feature3: See upcoming pickups on the calendar

step2.title: Dashboard Reminders
step2.description: The dashboard shows your next scheduled pickup so you never forget to take out the trash.
step2.feature1: Upcoming pickup shown on the dashboard
step2.feature2: Color-coded waste types for quick recognition

step1.title: Stay on Top of Home Maintenance
step1.description: Schedule and track all the recurring maintenance tasks your home needs to stay in shape.
step1.feature1: Set due dates and priority levels
step1.feature2: Mark tasks as complete when done

step2.title: Recurring Tasks Made Easy
step2.description: Set a recurring schedule (monthly, yearly, etc.) and the task will reappear automatically.
step2.feature1: Supports daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly schedules
step2.feature2: Never forget annual checks like smoke detectors or filter changes

step1.title: Track Your Energy Usage
step1.description: Log monthly meter readings for electricity, water, and heating to monitor your household consumption.
step1.feature1: Enter readings for power, water, and heating
step1.feature2: Add cost per unit for accurate billing estimates

step2.title: Visualize Your Consumption
step2.description: Charts and history let you spot trends, compare months, and catch unusual spikes in usage.

step1.title: Subscription & Contract Central
step1.description: Keep an eye on every subscription, contract, and recurring cost so nothing slips through the cracks.
step1.feature2: Mark trials to avoid auto-renewing unexpectedly

step2.title: Spot the Dead Weight
step2.description: Subscriptions you haven't used in a while are highlighted so you can decide whether to cancel them.
step2.feature1: Log when you last used each service
step2.feature2: See next billing date to plan cancellations

step1.title: Plan Your Home Improvements
step1.description: Create projects for everything you want to do or buy for your home, and track your savings toward each goal.
step1.feature1: Set an estimated cost and track current savings
step1.feature2: Assign urgency levels from nice-to-have to emergency

step2.title: Watch Your Savings Grow
step2.description: Each project shows a progress bar so you can see at a glance how close you are to your goal.
step2.feature2: Update savings whenever you set money aside

step1.title: The Lend-O-Meter
step1.description: Track everything you've lent to friends and family so you actually get it back.
step1.feature1: Record what you lent, to whom, and when
step1.feature3: Assign a trust level to each borrower

step2.title: Know Who to Trust
step2.description: The trust level system helps you remember which borrowers reliably return things — and which don't.
step2.feature2: Dashboard shows overdue items at a glance

step1.title: Identity Guard
step1.description: Keep all important personal documents organized so you always know when they expire and where they are.
step1.feature1: Store passports, IDs, and driver's licenses
step1.feature3: Record where the physical document is kept

step2.title: Expiry Alerts
step2.description: Documents nearing their expiry date are flagged automatically, giving you time to renew before it's too late.
step2.feature1: Color-coded expiry status (valid, expiring soon, expired)
step2.feature2: Manage documents for your whole household

step3.title: Emergency Preparedness
step3.description: Add emergency contacts and a lost/stolen guide for each document so you know exactly what to do if something goes missing.

step1.title: Your Pet Management Hub
step1.description: Keep all your pet's information in one place — from microchip numbers to dietary needs for pet sitters.
step1.feature1: Create profiles for each pet with species, breed, and birthday
step1.feature2: Store microchip numbers and emergency care instructions
step1.feature3: Add dietary needs and medications for pet-sitter handoffs

step2.title: Vet Record Tracking
step2.description: Log every vet visit with date, description, and cost. Set reminders for upcoming check-ups.
step2.feature1: Track visit dates, vet names, and treatment descriptions
step2.feature2: Record costs and schedule next appointments

step3.title: Vaccination Schedule
step3.description: Never miss a booster shot. Track every vaccination with its due date and get notified when it's time to renew.

step1.title: Track Every Illness
step1.description: Log each illness separately for every family member using your shared household person list.
step1.feature1: Reuse the same person records as Identity Guard
step1.feature2: Capture the illness name, start date, and end date
step1.feature3: Keep optional notes for symptoms, recovery, or follow-ups

step2.title: Family History at a Glance
step2.description: Switch between family members to review their individual illness history without mixing everyone together.
step2.feature1: Dedicated timeline cards for each illness entry
step2.feature2: Per-person yearly summaries with tracked sick days

step3.title: GitHub-Style Sick-Day Heatmap
step3.description: Each person gets a year-by-year activity grid so you can see how many days they were sick over time.
